WITH telescope_weather_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    s.telescref,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modulation_index,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift
  FROM signals AS s
  INNER JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  INNER JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modulation_index
  FROM signals
)
SELECT
  twa.weathprofile,
  AVG(twa.avg_modulation_index) AS avg_modulation_index,
  AVG(twa.avg_phase_shift) AS avg_phase_shift,
  AVG(twa.avg_modulation_index - oa.avg_modulation_index) AS avg_above_overall_modulation_index
FROM telescope_weather_avgs AS twa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa
WHERE twa.avg_modulation_index > oa.avg_modulation_index
GROUP BY twa.weathprofile;
